instruction.text: Choose the word that best completes each sentence to create alliteration.

atoms.b: The terrible ((++tiger monster giant dragon)) terrorised the tiny town.
Dancing ((++daisies flowers fireflies leaves)) dazzled in the dawn light.
Wild ((++wolves rabbits mice swans)) wandered through the woods.
Playful ((++puppies children dolls birds)) pranced through the park.

instruction.text: Choose the word that best completes each sentence to create assonance.

atoms.b: I beat the ((++heat freeze sun)) with treats of sweet lemonade.
The ((++kite bird plane)) flew high in the bright sky.
Hot dogs ((++cost sell rent)) a lot at the shop.
Go ((++slow carefully now)) over the winding road.

instruction.text: Choose the word that best completes each sentence to create onomatopoeia.

atoms.b: The bees went ((++buzz_buzz fly_fly slam_slam)) around the flowers.
((++Pitter-patter Splash Ping-pong)) went the raindrops on the roof all night.

wrong.text: Splash imitates the sound of someone playing in or jumping into water.

atoms.b: ((++Bang Crash Pop))! The door slammed shut in the wind.
((++Ribbit Meow Roar)) went the frog as it jumped into the pond.
